ambiguity: Planet not named here; continues the Venus-Ketu thought.
classical_check: Classical texts speak of grahas forcing karma, so the idea is compatible, but this specific application is his own.

hindi: इसलिए किसी तीसरे ने बताया तो अब भरवा लो अब उसके कहने से भरवाओ दूसरे की औररा से होगा
says: The remedy path is that a third person must tell you, and then you act on that person's word; the work gets done through another person's aura.
ambiguity: 'औररा' (aura) is his own term; meaning is a push coming from someone outside the person's own chart.
classical_check: Not found in classical texts; his personal doctrine of 'other person's aura' breaking a planet's block.

hindi: आप कितनी कोशिश करोगे आपसे नहीं होगा क्योंकि आपका ग्रह होने ही नहीं देगा आप कर ही नहीं सकते
says: However hard the native tries by himself it will not work, since his own planet will not let it happen; self-effort is useless against this block.
ambiguity: Planet is not named, but the context is the afflicted Venus.
classical_check: Parashari texts accept strong graha obstruction but also prescribe self-remedies, so this is stronger than classical.

hindi: आप दारू छोड़ दो कैसे छोड़ दो कुंडली कह रही है दारू पिलाऊंगी
says: He gives the drinking example: you tell someone to quit liquor, but how can he quit when the chart is saying 'I will make you drink'. Alcohol habit is attributed to the afflicted Venus. Recorded as his claim only.
ambiguity: Planet is not named in this sentence; Venus is named in the next one.
classical_check: Venus is a classical karaka of pleasures and intoxicants; a chart 'compelling' a habit is his phrasing.

hindi: शुक्र कहता है नीच का है खराब है तीन नंबर राशि है वो कहता है हां पिएंगे कम पिएंगे कभी ज्यादा पिएंगे
says: Venus, being weak and in a bad sign (he says 'number 3 sign'), says 'yes, we will drink, sometimes less and sometimes more'; so the afflicted Venus keeps the drinking going.
cells_derived_method: Venus in a weak sign: the habit-forming pull is read into the house where Venus sits; Venus in Gemini is not debilitated, so derived readings treat it as an unsupported sign for Venus.

derived_examples.reading: Venus in Gemini in the 12th (lagna Cancer, derived): indulgence in bed-pleasures and drink hidden or in private.
Venus in Gemini in the 11th (lagna Leo, derived): the habit comes through friends and social circle.

ambiguity: He says 'नीच का' (debilitated) together with 'three number rashi', but Venus is debilitated in Virgo (6), not Gemini (3); so either the caption or his number is wrong, or he means house 3.
classical_check: Classical texts: Venus is debilitated in Virgo only; Gemini is the sign of Mercury, a friend of Venus.

hindi: अब लड़ाई कर रहे हो नहीं आपको दूसरे की औररा के कहने से ही छूटो
says: He closes the thought: do not fight the habit on your own; you get free only through someone else's aura.
ambiguity: Caption is partly garbled after 'लड़ाई कर रहे हो'.
classical_check: Not classical; same idea as his earlier aura remark.

hindi: छूटेगा अदरवाइज छूट ही नहीं सकता असंभव है
says: The habit will leave only through another person's influence; otherwise it cannot leave at all, he calls it impossible.
ambiguity: Whether 'impossible' is meant literally or as emphasis.
classical_check: Not classical.

gist: He jokes that some yogas are coming and the audience keeps staring at him, so he feels tension.

hindi: मान लेते हैं यहां छह नंबर का शुक्र है
says: Take Venus sitting in the number 6 position as his working example; in context this means the debilitation sign Virgo.
cells_derived_method: Venus in Virgo is the debilitated case; the house it falls in decides which life topic is harmed.

derived_examples.reading: Venus in Virgo in the 6th (lagna Aries, derived): debilitated in the house of disease and enemies.
Venus in Virgo in the 4th (lagna Gemini, derived): debilitated in the house of home, chest and mother.
Venus in Virgo in the 9th (lagna Capricorn, derived): debilitated in the house of fortune; luck and dharma matters weakened.

ambiguity: 'Number 6' could be the sixth sign (Virgo) or the sixth house; the next sentence says debilitated, which fits Virgo.
classical_check: Venus debilitated in Virgo is classical.

gist: He repeats 'here is Venus number 6' while pointing at the chart.

hindi: यह बड़ा अजीब और क्रांतिकारी बात है यह प्रयोग में देखा हमने
says: He says what follows is strange and revolutionary, and claims it is based on observation from practice, not from a text.
ambiguity: Empirical claim without sample size or data.
classical_check: By his own account this is not from a classical text.

hindi: यहां पर तो नीच का हो गया यह छाती को खा जाएगा खराब कर देता है काम का नाश कर देता है
says: Venus in the debilitated position eats up the chest and spoils it, and destroys 'kaam' (work or desire). Recorded as a body-part tradition claim, not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: Debilitated Venus damaging the chest connects with the 4th house (chest in the house-body map) and Cancer; effect is stronger when Venus sits in or aspects the 4th, or when the 4th lord is weak.

derived_examples.reading: Venus in Virgo in the 4th (lagna Gemini, derived): debilitated directly in the chest house, strongest version of the claim.
Venus in Virgo in the 10th (lagna Sagittarius, derived): aspects the 4th, so chest effect plus damage to career work.
Venus in Virgo in the 7th (lagna Pisces, derived): 'kaam' read as sexual desire or marriage drive being weakened.

ambiguity: 'काम का नाश' can mean destruction of work or of sexual desire; he does not say which.
classical_check: Venus governs reproductive health, not the chest, in classical texts; chest is the 4th house topic. Link here is his own.

hindi: अगर ऐसे व्यक्ति को छाती संबंधित कोई परेशानी हो रही है रोग हो रहा है फेफड़ों का हो गया किसी किस्म का हड्डियों का हो गया और डॉक्टर ने कह दिया मर जाओगे
says: He sets a scenario: a person with this Venus placement who has a chest, lung or bone illness and has been told by a doctor that he will die. No timing is given; recorded as scenario only.
cells_derived_method: Scenario depends on Venus debilitation affecting the 4th (chest) or the 6th (disease); no distinct cell reading is given by him.

derived_examples.reading: Venus in Virgo in the 6th (lagna Aries, derived): the illness-house case, where he would expect such a scenario.

ambiguity: Sets up the paradox in the next sentence; not a prediction.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: ऐसे लोग अगर स्मोक करते हैं वो ठीक हो जाते हैं
says: He claims such people recover if they smoke. This is a medical-sounding claim about smoking helping the chest; recorded as his statement only and not endorsed.
cells_derived_method: None beyond the placement; claim is about the person's habit, not the cell.
ambiguity: Whether 'smoke' means tobacco or cannabis is explained in the following lines.
classical_check: No classical basis.

hindi: क्या अजीबोगरीब बात है ये कौन सी पॉजिटिव बात है ये तो बहुत गंदी बात है पर वो बचते हैं इसके ऊपर स्टडी हो चुकी है
says: He admits this sounds ugly and not positive, but says these people do survive, and claims a study has been done on it. No study is named.
ambiguity: Claimed study is not identified, so it cannot be checked.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Medical marijuana is sold for cancer patients in foreign countries, and our body has cannabinoid receptors (sentence completes at the start of the next timestamp).
Completes the cannabinoid receptor remark: receptors for it are built into the body.

hindi: शिव जो कहते हैं भांग पीते हैं वो कनेबीस के नशे के कारण से ही ब्रेन को सेट करते हैं
says: He says Shiva's bhang drinking is really cannabis acting to set the brain, using it to explain why intoxicant effects on the brain are not random.
ambiguity: Mythological reading; not a Jyotish rule.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Adds that Shiva is no addict but our God.
Repeats that the body has cannabinoid receptors and wonders why they exist in the brain.

hindi: क्योंकि ग्रह कहता है कि केतु का बादल यदि इस पर आ जाएगा तो छाती को पूर्ण रूप से रक्षा कर देगा ब्रेन में आ जाएगा छाती को सिर को पूर्ण रूप से रक्षा कर देगा
says: Because of the planet's logic: if Ketu's 'cloud' (influence) falls on this afflicted Venus, it will fully protect the chest and also the head and brain.
cells_derived_method: Ketu's cover on Venus protects the body parts that Venus damages in that chart, so the 4th house (chest) and 1st house (head) are the protected topics; effect only counts where Ketu really joins or falls on Venus.

derived_examples.reading: Ketu with debilitated Venus in the 4th in Virgo (lagna Gemini, derived): protection for the chest.
Ketu with Venus in the lagna in Virgo (lagna Virgo, derived): protection for the head and brain.
Ketu with Venus in the 6th in Virgo (lagna Aries, derived): protection read as defence against disease and enemies.

ambiguity: 'बादल' (cloud) is figurative; he does not say if it means conjunction or aspect.
classical_check: Classical texts treat Ketu as a malefic that spoils what it joins; this protective reading is his own doctrine of Ketu cancelling Venus damage.

hindi: तो केतु का व्यसन ठीक करता है
says: So Ketu cures addiction (vyasan); Ketu's contact is his way of curing a Venus-driven habit.
ambiguity: Conflicts with the common view that Ketu can itself cause addictions.
classical_check: Classical texts do not give Ketu a de-addiction role.

gist: Village anecdotes: people smoke hookah and beedi day and night, even women, and nothing seems to happen to their lungs.

hindi: वहां वो उसको हेल्प कर रहा है यानी शुक्र की नेगेटिविटी को किल करने के लिए इसका मामा इसके साथ लगा दो केतु
says: Ketu is helping Venus there: to kill Venus's negativity, put its 'maternal uncle' Ketu with it. He treats Ketu as a relative who cancels Venus's bad effect.
cells_derived_method: Works wherever Venus is afflicted, with the cancelling effect measured in the house topic of that placement.

derived_examples.reading: Ketu with debilitated Venus in the 7th in Virgo (lagna Pisces, derived): Ketu is read as reducing Venus's marriage and desire damage.
Ketu with Venus in the 12th in Gemini (lagna Cancer, derived): reduces bed and indulgence excess.

ambiguity: Calling Ketu Venus's 'mama' is a family-metaphor; his scheme of planet relations is not given here.
classical_check: In Parashari friendship tables, Ketu has no fixed relation to Venus; this is his own metaphor.

hindi: केतु अगर ऐसी स्थिति बन जाती है तो आपको पूर्ण रूप से बचाव होता है
says: He summarises the outcome: when Ketu forms this position with Venus, the native gets complete safety (not just the chest) from the Venus damage.
cells_derived_method: Same condition as the earlier rule; the type of protection follows the house Venus holds.

derived_examples.reading: Ketu with Venus in the 2nd in Virgo (lagna Leo, derived): protection of wealth and speech from Venus misuse.
Ketu with Venus in the 5th in Virgo (lagna Taurus, derived): protection of children and romance matters.

ambiguity: 'Complete protection' is a strong claim and he adds a caution right after (next lines).
classical_check: Not classical.

gist: He says there is a strange medicine and he will not call it permanent; sentence continues in the next timestamp.
Disclaimer: he is not a medical doctor though his knowledge is good, and jokes that this boast comes from pride.

hindi: लेकिन बहुत ज्यादा शक की स्थिति कई बार लेडीज को होती है तो उसके लिए एक मेडिसिन आती है वो उनको दिखा बताएं जो मैं बता नहीं रहा
says: Excessive suspicion (shak) often troubles women, and a medicine exists for it; he tells listeners to show it to them but does not name it. Recorded as his remedy claim, not medical advice.
ambiguity: Which planet governs the suspicion is not stated here.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: ऐसे बोलूं पल्सला नहीं बोला मैंने बोल दिया अच्छा वो लेते रहेंगे कभी कबभार तो उससे शक की गुंजाइश उड़ जाएगी या चमत्कारिक चीजें होम्योपैथिक मेडिसिन
says: He slips and names the homeopathic medicine (Pulsatilla, heard as 'pulsala'); if taken now and then, he says doubt disappears, and homeopathic medicines work like miracles. His claim only, not endorsed.
ambiguity: Name is a caption corruption of Pulsatilla; low confidence on exact medicine.
classical_check: Homeopathy is outside Jyotish texts.

gist: Jumbled aside about who is doubting and how to keep telling people the name of the medicine, calling it very peculiar.

hindi: अच्छा इसके हजारों इफेक्ट्स हैं सिर्फ यही नहीं है पर ये मन में खुलापन लाती है ई करती है नहीं तो लड़ के पागल हो जाते हैं
says: He says this medicine has thousands of effects beyond just reducing doubt, that it brings openness to the mind, and without it people fight and go mad. Medical claim recorded only.
ambiguity: A word is garbled ('ई करती है').
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: क्योंकि खोपड़ी में एक विचार जो घुस गया तो घुस गया रोते रहो मरते रहो
says: He explains why: once a suspicious thought gets lodged in the head it stays, and the person keeps suffering. This is his psychological reasoning for the medicine, not a chart rule.
ambiguity: None.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: He says he shares this for the good of humanity, while the disclaimer is that we know nothing about it.
Disclaimer continues: whoever wants to use it should do it on their own responsibility; caption is partly garbled about a guarantee.
He says people often know a lot but do not share it.
Garbled lines about homeopathy and people burning with ego, asking to keep coming back.
A computer-repair baba visits him; he has not yet fallen into his trap, he jokes.
The baba keeps several computers linked so a file transfers across all, and it breaks every fourth or sixth day.
He asks the man to teach him; the man refuses out of fear of losing his value.
He retorts that the man's value is ending anyway by not sharing, and that each time the problem returns for five or six days.
Files then come on a pen drive and he feeds them in at his end.
Moral: people do not share what they know and even big people hide this matter, like the white pills in circulation.

hindi: यह एक बहुत बड़ी समस्या बन जाती है शुक्र के कारण क्योंकि धातु शरीर में बनना खत्म हो जाता है या कम हो जाता है
says: This becomes a big problem because of Venus, since the body's dhatu (reproductive essence) stops forming or reduces. He ties an afflicted Venus to loss of vitality. Recorded as a tradition claim, not a medical statement.
cells_derived_method: Venus is the karaka of dhatu; the damage shows more when Venus is weak in houses 1, 7 or 8, or in water signs.

derived_examples.reading: Venus in Virgo in the 8th (lagna Aquarius, derived): debilitated in the house of the reproductive organs and vitality.
Venus in Virgo in the 7th (lagna Pisces, derived): debilitated in the house of sexual partnership.

ambiguity: The sentence crosses the timestamp, so the first half sits in 1:40:02 and the end in 1:41:09.
classical_check: Venus as karaka of shukra dhatu and sexual vigour is classical.

gist: Warns to take seriously that misuse of the medicine will cause side effects.
Homeopathic drawback: if you have no illness and take a remedy, the same medicine can first give you that disease, so strongly that it may not respond to cure later.
Withdrawal symptoms: even after stopping, the body keeps looking for the disease the drug was meant to kill, so the same medicine can give the illness.
Advice to be very careful and to befriend a good practitioner, even give him a bottle.

hindi: क्योंकि शनि आंखें खोलता है शुक्र की चंद्रमा की कृपा मिलती है तब
says: Saturn opens the eyes (brings awareness), and then one receives the grace of Venus and the Moon. A fragment tying Saturn's awakening to help from Venus and Moon.
ambiguity: Clause begins mid-thought and ends with 'तब', so the link to the previous bottle remark is unclear.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Says this is a fact and promises to use it when the Rahu class comes.
Asks why big decisions in big clubs happen over liquor, why bottles are gifted, and whether that is not sin; sentence is cut at the end of the slice.

hindi: बड़े-बड़े ऑफिशियल सिर्फ मुंडी हिलाते हैं सिर्फ मुंडी राहु टॉप पर बैठे ऑफिशियल्स करना धरना कुछ नहीं सिर्फ मुंडी हिलाते हैं कलम चलाते हैं
says: Rahu is the significator of the very top officials who do nothing themselves; they only nod their heads and move the pen to sign.
cells_derived_method: Rahu strongly placed in or influencing the 10th house (authority) gives top desk-signature positions; in other houses the same nodding-and-signing nature shows in that house's field.

derived_examples.reading: Rahu in Virgo in the 10th (lagna Sagittarius, derived): senior administrative position with signing power.
Rahu in Gemini in the 11th (lagna Leo, derived): approvals, deals and commissions from the desk, gains through signatures.
Rahu in Scorpio in the 6th (lagna Gemini, derived): authority in service, defence or legal wings, working by approval rather than effort.

ambiguity: He says 'top' of Rahu; whether this means the 10th house or Rahu's general nature is not stated; the 10th is my reading.
classical_check: Rahu as karaka of bureaucrats and politicians is a common modern reading; Parashara gives Rahu foreigners, outcastes and illusions.

hindi: वहां दारू चलती है बहुत बड़े-बड़े आर्मी के अंदर दारू के ऊपर काम किया जाता है बहुत कुछ बड़े-बड़े कॉन्ट्रैक्ट्स होते हैं
says: In Rahu's world of high offices and the army, liquor is part of work; many large contracts are struck over drinks. Rahu is tied to liquor and big deal-making.
ambiguity: He is describing an observation, not a rule about a chart cell.
classical_check: Rahu as karaka of intoxicants is classical; the army and contracts link is his example.

gist: He names a prominent political leader as a Jupiter-type 'maharaj' who does not drink, and says this shows very high consciousness; his opinion on a living public figure, not astrology.

hindi: किसी किसी के पास तो इरेक्टाइल डिस्फंक्शन जैसी प्रॉब्लम के अंदर जब ये स्थिति बन जाती है तो सेक्सुअल लाइफ खराब हो जाती है कॉन्फिडेंस डेड हो जाता है और पुरुष अपने आप में मरने मरना आने को हो जाता है
says: In some men, when the afflicted-Venus situation forms and erectile dysfunction appears, the sexual life is ruined, confidence dies and the man feels he is finished inside. Recorded as his claim, not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: Afflicted or debilitated Venus acting on the 7th (sex partner), 8th (sexual organs) or 1st (body and confidence) shows this; in other houses the same Venus weakness shows in that house's topic instead.

derived_examples.reading: Venus in Virgo in the 7th (lagna Pisces, derived): debilitated in the house of sexual partnership, the most direct reading.
Venus in Aries in the 8th (lagna Virgo, derived): Venus in the house of the sexual organs and hidden matters.
Venus in Virgo in the lagna (lagna Virgo, derived): confidence and body vitality carry the Venus weakness.

ambiguity: He says 'this situation' without repeating which exact placement; context is the afflicted Venus of the last class.
classical_check: Venus as karaka of potency is classical; the specific disorder name is his modern wording.

hindi: स्त्री की स्थिति भी ऐसी हो जाती है कि वह खुद भी परेशान हो जाती है उसकी उसकी उसके बॉडी के अंदर ऑटोमेटिकली ड्रनेस की स्थिति बननी शुरू हो जाती है सेक्सुअल लिबिडो खत्म हो जाता है
says: A woman with the same Venus affliction also suffers: dryness starts forming in her body by itself and her sexual desire ends. A body-condition claim, recorded without endorsement.
cells_derived_method: In a woman's chart Venus is the main karaka; the 7th and 8th houses and the Moon are secondary markers; Venus afflicted in water signs would dry or distort the response, other houses move the effect to their own topic.

derived_examples.reading: Venus in Virgo in the 8th (lagna Aquarius, derived): debilitated in the house of intimacy for a woman.
Venus in Cancer in the 5th (lagna Pisces, derived): affected pleasure and romance desire.

ambiguity: The caption repeats pronouns ('उसकी उसकी') so the subject is a woman, inferred.
classical_check: Classical texts give Venus as karaka for women's reproductive matters; the dryness claim is modern.

hindi: स्त्री का सेक्सुअल लिबिडो खत्म हो तो मेडिसिन है लाइकोपोडियम
says: For a woman whose libido has ended, he names the homeopathic medicine Lycopodium. Medical or drug advice: recorded as his statement only, not endorsed, not for engine output.
ambiguity: Name is heard from the caption; likely Lycopodium clavatum.
classical_check: Homeopathy is outside the Jyotish texts.

says: The only trick is the potency: it could be 30, 200 or 1M, depending on the case. Medical or drug advice: recorded as his statement only, not endorsed, not for engine output.

hindi: अगर तो बिल्कुल ही मन मरा हुआ है इच्छा नहीं है कई बार पति तंग करता है फिर नहीं तो बाहर चला जाता है
says: If the mind is completely dead and there is no desire, the husband often harasses her, or otherwise goes outside the marriage; he uses this to pick the strongest potency (1M).

hindi: परिवार टूट जाते हैं ये बहुत बड़ी समस्या है सेक्स को लेकर के बड़ी भारी समस्या है
says: Families break up over this, and he calls it a very big, heavy problem around sex, to stress why he is covering it.
ambiguity: None.

hindi: ये 1 एम की दो-दो बूंद दिन में दो बार लेके तीन दिन ले लोगे फिर लेनी ही नहीं है ये आपका लिबिडो सेट कर देगी हर हालत के अंदर
says: Dose he gives for the woman's medicine: 1M potency, two drops twice a day for three days, then stop; he claims it resets the libido in every condition. Medical or drug advice: recorded as his statement only, not endorsed, not for engine output.

says: What work will they do then? No shop and no house, and things run in secret, in 'number two' dealings; in any way they cannot do genuine work. A claim about unaccounted work, recorded as his statement only.
ambiguity: This is a harsh generalisation without conditions.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Question: is this limited to an age bracket or in any work forever?

hindi: बच्चे के जैसे पार्टी अगर पांच साल की ऐज तक चंद्रमा वीक होता है बच्चे का 10 साल के
says: For a child, parties should be avoided up to age 5 if the child's Moon is weak, and (the sentence runs on) up to 10 years; the age limit follows the weak Moon.
cells_derived_method: Moon weak by sign (Scorpio) or house (6, 8, 12) is the trigger; the age limit stretches with the severity.

derived_examples.reading: Moon debilitated in Scorpio in the 8th (lagna Aries, derived): weakest case, avoid parties for the longest age.
Moon exalted in Taurus in the 4th (lagna Aquarius, derived): not weak, no restriction.

ambiguity: Sentence is cut at '10 साल के' at the end of the slice.
classical_check: Moon governing childhood to about age 4 and Mercury to 12 has classical parallels.

hindi: बाद सूर्य पकड़ेगा 16 में बृहस्पति पकड़ेगा ग्रहों की पावर पकड़ने दो
says: Continuing his age-by-age handover of the child's life: after the earlier phase the Sun takes hold, and around age 16 Jupiter takes hold, so each planet's power matters in its own age window.
cells_derived_method: none: this is an age-window sequence, not tied to a particular house or sign; the strength of the Sun or Jupiter in the chart would decide how good that window is.
ambiguity: Caption starts mid-thought; the earlier ages (Moon until 5) are in the previous batch, so the exact handover ages for the Sun are not clear here.
classical_check: Classical bala-graha (childhood planetary rulership by year) schemes exist but differ in ages; no classical text gives Jupiter at 16 exactly.

hindi: चंद्रमा वीक है नीच का है पांच साल की ऐज तक तो बच्चे की करनी नहीं चाहिए पार्टी
says: If the child's Moon is weak or debilitated, no party or birthday celebration should be thrown for the child until about age five, because the Moon governs that early period.
cells_derived_method: Moon is debilitated only in Scorpio; the house changes which life area is hit: house 1 hits the child's own body and temperament, house 4 hits home and mother-bond, house 8 hits health and sudden events, house 12 hits sleep and losses.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: debilitated Moon in the 1st house, lagna Scorpio; the child's own constitution and mood are the delicate point, so crowds and parties are the thing to avoid.
Derived: debilitated Moon in the 4th house, lagna Leo; home, mother and comfort are the weak area, so a party at home is the risky event.
Derived: debilitated Moon in the 8th house, lagna Aries; the sensitivity is to sudden health and emotional shocks, so exposure to many people is the risk.

ambiguity: Says weak and debilitated together; weak could also mean afflicted or combust, not only Scorpio.
classical_check: Classical texts give Moon rulership of the first four years; the party prohibition itself is his own practice, classical texts are silent.

hindi: हां अगर सातवां और चौथा घर पांचवा घर आपका गड़बड़ है
says: The same caution on parties applies if the 7th, 4th and 5th houses of the chart are troubled, not only when the Moon is weak.
cells_derived_method: Each of these houses is touched by two or three signs, so the trouble depends on which signs fall in them: a fiery or watery sign with a malefic hurts differently from an earthy sign with a benefic.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 4th house in Aries, lagna Capricorn; the home life is hot and restless, so a noisy home party tends to produce friction.
Derived: 5th house in Pisces, lagna Scorpio; child and joy matters are soft and over-sensitive, so celebration around the child needs care.
Derived: 7th house in Scorpio, lagna Taurus; partner and public dealings carry hidden tension, so inviting many people brings conflict.

ambiguity: Caption is choppy; it is not clear whose houses (child's or parents') he means, or why 7th is included.
classical_check: Classical texts silent on a party rule; 4th, 5th, 7th are standard houses of home, children and partner.

hindi: अगर आपका चौथे घर के अंदर मान लो कोई ग्रह वीक है
says: A weak planet sitting inside the 4th house is the specific trigger he singles out for avoiding the celebration; the rest of the sentence about parents and spouse is not recoverable.
cells_derived_method: Any weak planet in the 4th house, with the house meaning home, mother, property, vehicles and peace; the planet's own nature decides which of these suffers, and the sign decides how.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: weak planet in Capricorn in the 4th house, lagna Libra; cold, delayed and heavy conditions at home and with property.
Derived: weak planet in Cancer in the 4th house, lagna Aries; emotional and mother-related disturbance at home, and Cancer is Moon's own sign so a weak non-Moon planet is unsettled.

ambiguity: The tail 'parents' wife or the child's wife' is garbled and not used.
classical_check: 4th house as home, mother, comfort is classical; weak planet there harming home is generally agreed, party aspect is his own.

hindi: क्योंकि पार्टी करते ही बच्चा छीन जाएगा हॉस्पिटल जाएंगे वो हॉस्पिटल जाना पड़ेगा उन्हें
says: His stated reason: right after the party the child will be weakened and the family will have to go to a hospital. This is his health claim recorded as said, not a medical diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: none: it is a consequence statement attached to the earlier weak-Moon or weak-4th conditions, not itself house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: The word he uses for what happens to the child may be a caption error for fall ill; meaning inferred from hospital.
classical_check: Classical texts silent on party-linked illness.

hindi: किसी के चौथे घर में कोई दोष है मंगल बैठ गया यहां पे चार नंबर का कोई भी बैठ सकता है
says: Example of a flaw in the 4th house: Mars has sat there, and any other planet of that number can sit there and do similar harm.
cells_derived_method: Mars in the 4th house heats home and property matters; its strength depends on sign: own sign Aries or Scorpio gives force with friction, exalted Capricorn gives strength, debilitated Cancer makes it weakest and most harmful.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in own sign Aries in the 4th house, lagna Capricorn; strong but quarrelsome home, property gained through effort.
Derived: Mars debilitated in Cancer in the 4th house, lagna Aries; weakest Mars at the home house, domestic peace and mother's comfort suffer most.
Derived: Mars exalted in Capricorn in the 4th house, lagna Libra; very strong Mars that gives land power yet the home stays tense.

ambiguity: 'Number four any one' could mean any planet that rules or relates to 4 (Rahu in numerology) or simply any planet in the fourth house.
classical_check: Mars in the 4th is a classical Manglik position that is said to disturb domestic peace; agrees.

hindi: बुध बैठ गया मान लो नौ नंबर का बृहस्पति के घर का नेगेटिव होता है बुध
says: Mercury sitting in Jupiter's house, which he calls number nine, is negative for the property question; Mercury gives trouble in that placement.
cells_derived_method: Mercury in Sagittarius (Jupiter's sign, number 9): effect depends on the house; in the 4th it touches home and property, in the 10th work and status, in the 7th partnership.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury in Sagittarius in the 4th house, lagna Virgo; Mercury is lagna and 10th lord in a house of property, so paperwork and advice on property go wrong.
Derived: Mercury in Sagittarius in the 10th house, lagna Pisces; Mercury rules the 4th and 7th houses and sits in the 10th in Jupiter's sign, so business and partner decisions are over-argued.

ambiguity: 'Nine number' could be the 9th sign Sagittarius or the 9th house; Jupiter's house points to Sagittarius but the 9th house is also Jupiter's natural house.
classical_check: Mercury and Jupiter are generally treated as non-friends; classical texts do not call Mercury in Sagittarius a property curse; partly differs.

hindi: प्रॉपर्टी लेते ही अगर आप पार्टी दोगे तो आपका हर हालत के अंदर उस प्रॉपर्टी में डिस्प्यूट और झगड़े रहेंगे इसलिए पार्टी मत दो
says: For a person with these 4th-house flaws, if you hold a party when you take a property, that property will carry disputes and quarrels in every situation, so do not give a party.
cells_derived_method: Applies to 4th-house flaws; a malefic in a fire sign gives open quarrel disputes, in an earth sign gives legal or ownership delays, in a water sign gives family disputes over the property.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: flawed 4th house in Leo, lagna Taurus; disputes over pride and authority in the property, shown by a party that is a show of status.
Derived: flawed 4th house in Taurus, lagna Aquarius; dispute is about ownership, money or papers of the property.

ambiguity: Whether this holds for every flawed 4th house or only the Mars and Mercury cases just named.
classical_check: Classical texts silent on party-linked property disputes; the 4th house as property is classical.

hindi: गृह प्रवेश के लिए पूजा पाठ करते हैं लोग वास्तु पूजन कराते हैं ऐसे व्यक्ति के लिए नेगेटिव है कराना
says: Although people normally do puja and vastu pujan for griha pravesh, for a person with such a flawed 4th house doing that ceremony is negative.
cells_derived_method: Linked to the 4th house being flawed; the ceremony counts as a gathering and display like the party, so it is read the same way across 4th-house signs.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: flawed 4th house in Virgo, lagna Gemini; ritual detail and criticism of the arrangements cause friction after the ceremony.
Derived: flawed 4th house in Sagittarius, lagna Virgo; religious show and big gathering turn into disagreement among relatives.

ambiguity: 'Such a person' is the one with 4th house flaws; it may be only the Mars and Mercury cases.
classical_check: Differs from classical practice, which prescribes griha pravesh puja and muhurta for everyone.

hindi: वो बिना मुहूर्त के चला जाए
says: Such a person should simply move into the house quietly without a muhurta ceremony.
cells_derived_method: none: it is the do-instruction that follows from the previous rule and does not change by sign.
ambiguity: Caption could also mean he may go ahead even without a muhurta; meaning taken as skip the ceremony.
classical_check: Differs from classical advice, which insists on muhurta for griha pravesh.

hindi: ऐसी स्थिति अलग-अलग ग्रहों की है
says: The picture differs from planet to planet; each planet in the 4th house gives its own version of this trouble, so a chart must be read case by case.
cells_derived_method: none: it is a general reminder that planet nature changes the reading.
classical_check: Agrees with the general classical principle that a house is read through its occupant's nature.

gist: He says this needs a lot of attention and is very complicated.
Audience question: you say a person may do number-two (hidden) work in profession, but a layman says do good social work.
Audience asks how one should tell the two apart or make the right one the base.
Questioner restates the same question: astrologers say do number-two work, the layman says good work, sin and virtue are drama.
Audience asks how a person decides in such a situation.

hindi: ये तो आपकी कुंडली डिसाइड करके देगी कि आपके कुंडली कौन सा वाला धन आपको पचाने देती है
says: Which kind of wealth you are able to digest, clean or unclean, is decided by your own chart, so the chart answers the right or wrong work question.
cells_derived_method: none: this is a chart-wide principle; the wealth houses 2 and 11 and the 6th, 8th and 12th would be what to check, but he does not say so.
ambiguity: Which chart factors he uses to decide is not stated here.
classical_check: Classical texts treat dhana yogas and sources of livelihood from the chart but do not speak of the chart permitting digestion of unclean money; silent.

gist: Remark that some people suffer even though they do genuine work.
Example of IAS officer Ashok Khemka, who was transferred 57 times.
Calls him extremely genuine and asks where God is when such a man is made to cry at the top of the bureaucracy.
Continues the Khemka example: a man at the top level crying, given 57 transfers and retired.
Says the genuine path gave him nothing but beatings.
Contrasts with officers who own thousands of crores of unaccounted money and jokes about where they keep it, in sacks.
Audience member mentions a judge in whose house lakhs and crores of rupees were found.
Audience member says astrologers should say that planets make people choose their life through multiple combinations.
Audience member adds that consciously troubling others has after-effects on one's own planets.
Audience member asks him to please add this point.

hindi: क्या काम करो क्या काम ना करो क्या प्रोफेशन चुनो भूल जाओ आप वही करोगे जो लिखा के लाए हो
says: Forget about choosing what work to do or which profession to pick; you will do only what you have brought written in your chart.
cells_derived_method: Profession is read from the 10th house, its sign and lord; since the claim is that destiny fixes it, the chart's 10th house decides, for example an earthy sign gives steady material work and a watery sign gives care or hidden work.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 10th house in Virgo, lagna Sagittarius; destined work is analysis, service or trade rather than a free choice.
Derived: 10th house in Scorpio, lagna Aquarius; destined work is investigation, research or hidden dealings.

ambiguity: He does not name the 10th house here; the cell is my reading of profession.
classical_check: Classical Jyotish also treats profession as fixed by the 10th house and its lord; agrees.

gist: Personal story: life beat him into becoming an astrologer though he was not interested and resisted for years.
Says life told him off and made him teach astrology classes.
He had decided for twenty years not to do it, and life forced him back.
Jokes that for thirty years he gave lectures on human consciousness and avoided classes.
Jokes that he may be made to teach history, tantra, the Mahabharata and the Gita next, as the goddess commands.

hindi: ईश्वर क्या-क्या कराना चाहता है तो हम वही कर रहे हैं जो हमें करना ही है
says: We do what God wants done through us; we are doing only what we were meant to do, so fate leads and not our plan.
cells_derived_method: none: it is a statement on fate, not tied to any house or sign.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical idea of prarabdha karma shown by the chart.

gist: Audience remark that someone else makes us do it and do not be under that delusion.

hindi: ये कोई करा रहा है तो आपने जो करना है ना आप वो करोगे ही तो ये तो टेंशन छोड़ दो क्या करना है
says: Since you will do what you are meant to do anyway, drop the tension about what to do; the only thing in your hands is what protection to take.
cells_derived_method: none: a general advice, not tied to a house or sign.
classical_check: Consistent with fatalistic strands in classical texts; silent on the advice to stop worrying.

hindi: अब एक ही बात आप कोई ढंग का जोशी देखो जो आपको सिर्फ प्रोटेक्शन दे सके
says: Find one competent astrologer whose only job is to give you protection, not to tell you what to do with your life.
classical_check: Classical texts silent; the astrologer's role as protector is his own view.

gist: Asks how to speak of a proper astrologer and repeats find an astrologer who gives only protection.

hindi: आपको उपाय के लिए सिर्फ एक काम करना है प्रोटेक्शन
says: For remedies there is only one thing to do: take protective measures against the bad period, not try to change what is destined.
classical_check: Differs from classical upaya, which claim to reduce the planet's effect; he limits remedy to protection.

hindi: आपको बाइक्स चलानी है जरूर चलाओ हेलमेट पहन लो
says: Example of protection: if you want to ride a bike, ride it, but wear a helmet.
classical_check: Silent; a practical safety example, not a classical remedy.

hindi: गाड़ी चलानी है जरूर चलाओ इंश्योरेंस करा लो सीट बेल्ट बांध लो
says: Example of protection: drive the car if you need to, but get it insured and wear the seat belt.
classical_check: Silent; practical advice, not classical.

hindi: आपको शादी करनी है जरूर करो शादी प्रोटेक्ट होनी चाहिए
says: Example of protection: if you want to marry, marry, but the marriage should be protected, meaning take the precautions the chart advises.
cells_derived_method: Marriage is the 7th house; the protection needed depends on its sign and occupants, for example a malefic in the 7th calls for more care in the choice and timing of marriage.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 7th house in Aries, lagna Libra; assertive partner, so protection means checking temper and compatibility before marriage.
Derived: 7th house in Cancer, lagna Capricorn; emotional and family-bound partner, so protection means managing the in-law and home relationship.

ambiguity: He does not say 7th house; cell is my reading of marriage.
classical_check: Silent on this phrasing; 7th as marriage is classical.

hindi: बच्चा पैदा करो प्रोटेक्शन प्रोटेक्शन के उपाय करो
says: Example of protection: have the child, but take protective measures around it, the same way as for marriage.
cells_derived_method: Children are the 5th house; the protection to take depends on its sign and occupants, for example a weak 5th lord asks for more care in pregnancy and early years.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 5th house in Leo, lagna Aries; strong child significations, so protection is about ego and health care of the first child.
Derived: 5th house in Capricorn, lagna Virgo; delayed or heavier child matters, so protection means medical planning and patience.

ambiguity: He does not say 5th house; cell is my reading of children.
classical_check: Silent on this phrasing; 5th as children is classical.

gist: Asks what people do about protection: they go to Fortis or Ganga Ram hospital, or make pickles; humour on the theme.
Says protection is like the heart, you can eat or drink anything, and jokes that poor liquor is blamed.
Gives statistics that 25 percent of heart and liver failures are among drinkers while 75 percent are not.
Says 22 percent of road accidents involve drunk drivers while the rest were not drinking, so what of them.

hindi: आपको प्रोटेक्शन से मतलब है आपकी प्रोटेक्शन पैसे कमाने हैं प्रोटेक्शन बुरे टाइम आता है तो उसकी प्रोटेक्शन का पैसा चाहिए
says: What you should care about is protection: even when earning money, keep money aside as protection, because when a bad time comes you will need money for that protection.
cells_derived_method: none: it is advice to keep reserves for the bad periods; it does not say which period or house, so no sign or house variation is derived.
ambiguity: Money advice here is general life planning, not investment advice; recorded only as said.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts speak of saving in good dasha for bad dasha only loosely.

hindi: आपको सिर्फ एक ही काम करना है यार मैं प्रोटेक्शन के उपाय करूंगा पूरी जिंदगी बाकी तो जो होना है होना ही है
says: The one thing you must do is take protective measures for your whole life; everything else that is to happen will happen anyway.
classical_check: Fatalistic stance; classical texts do allow remedies to modify events, so this is narrower than the classical view.

gist: Analogy: people eat almonds and good food all their life as protection against a bad time.
Covid example: India survived because vaccines were developed, which was protection.

hindi: हमारा काम सिर्फ प्रोटेक्शन डॉक्टर प्रोटेक्ट करता है ज्योतिषी प्रोटेक्ट करता है
says: Our work is only protection: the doctor protects the body and the astrologer protects the person from what the chart shows, and neither changes destiny.
classical_check: Silent; this is his own definition of the astrologer's role.

hindi: गुरु तो कभी भी हेल्प नहीं करता वो कहता है इसे पिट लेने दे एक्सपीरियंस कैसे लेगा बड़ा कैसे होगा बच्चा
says: A true teacher (guru, possibly also Jupiter) never helps in the moment and instead lets the pupil take the beating, because a child cannot gain experience or grow otherwise.
cells_derived_method: none: the claim is about the guru role; if read as Jupiter, the karaka of teacher, it would mean Jupiter's periods bring lessons and not rescue, but he does not say so.
ambiguity: Guru can mean a human teacher or the planet Jupiter (also called Guru); the sentence reads like a human teacher.
classical_check: Silent on Jupiter letting one suffer; Jupiter as protector is the classical view, so reading as Jupiter would differ.

hindi: आपको प्रोटेक्शन चाहिए सर परमात्मा से मत भीख मांगो हे भगवान मकान दिला दे
says: What you need is protection, so do not beg God for a house or other gain; asking the Almighty for outcomes is the wrong use of prayer.
cells_derived_method: House is the 4th, but he uses it only as an example of a demand; no sign variation is meant.
ambiguity: The house wish is just an example of begging for outcomes.
classical_check: Differs from classical practice, in which prayer and rituals are prescribed to obtain wishes.

hindi: अबे कोई गुरु बनाओ जिसे अक्कल है उसे आजमाओ
says: Instead of begging God, choose a teacher or astrologer who has real sense and test him before trusting.
classical_check: Classical texts do call for choosing a qualified guru; agrees in spirit.

hindi: पट्ठे को धो नहीं लगा कैंसिल दूसरा तीसरा छठा सिलेक्ट करो
says: If the first astrologer or guru does not work out, cancel him and try a second, third or sixth one; do not stay stuck with a failed choice.
ambiguity: The phrase about the first one is partly garbled; meaning taken from cancel and select another.
classical_check: Silent on switching astrologers.

hindi: आपके पास शोरूम पे जाते हो 50 चीजें ऐसे 50 डॉक्टर हैं सैकड़ों गुरु हैं ले लो दो चार गलत टेबल क्या फर्क पड़ता है
says: Compares this with a showroom: there are fifty choices, fifty doctors and hundreds of gurus, so try several, and even two or four wrong ones make little difference as long as you reach a good one.
ambiguity: One word (table) is likely a caption error and is ignored.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Says a child is taught for twenty years, an analogy for patience in choosing; sentence cut off at the end of the batch.
Analogy: a student may fail first, second, third, fourth time, so what, the next chance comes.
Says to the failed child: do some other course, do hotel management.

hindi: शुक्र होटल मैनेजमेंट कराता है
says: Venus is the planet that takes a person into hotel management, so a strong or active Venus points to hospitality, food service and luxury trades.
cells_derived_method: Venus gives the field; the house shows how it is used: 10th house for a career in hospitality, 2nd house for earning from food and service, 5th house for studying it. The sign of Venus shows strength: own Taurus or Libra and exalted Pisces are strong.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus in own sign Taurus in the 10th house, lagna Leo; hospitality or luxury work becomes the visible career.
Derived: Venus in own sign Libra in the 2nd house, lagna Virgo; income from food, service and pleasing customers.
Derived: Venus exalted in Pisces in the 5th house, lagna Scorpio; education and creative skill in hotel and culinary courses.

ambiguity: He says Venus makes the person take the course; it is not stated whether this is Venus in any position or Venus tied to the 10th house.
classical_check: Venus as karaka of luxury, food, comforts and arts is classical; hotel management as a profession is a modern mapping, classical texts silent.

gist: Says thank you, apparently to someone in the audience, and repeats that one can just do hotel management.
Says you keep trying until the right path is found, as treatment goes on until the right doctor is found.
Joke: treatment goes on fifteen or twenty years, as a wife works on her husband for twenty years until he improves.
Joke continued: the man tires and asks his wife for divorce.
An audience member starts a question; he interrupts that the marriage talk is getting interesting but he is scared at this time.

hindi: इसलिए प्रोटेक्शन पे ध्यान दो समस्या क्या है प्रोटेक्शन के हम उपाय नहीं करते
says: So put your attention on protection; the real problem is that people do not actually carry out protective remedies for themselves.
classical_check: Silent; the framing of remedies as protection only is his own.

gist: Joke: for the maternal uncle we buy an expensive biscuit box or give almonds and cashews, for ourselves a cheap Parle-G.
Repeats that we are not willing to spend on almonds or remedies for ourselves.
Says in his whole life he has attended only unhappy people.
Says happy people run away; his work is like a doctor's and no happy person comes to the doctor.
Says do the treatment, then asks what to do.

hindi: बढ़िया घर बनाएंगे घर बनाएंगे प्रोटेक्शन के लिए तो बनाएंगे किस लिए बनाएंगे
says: People build a good house for protection, so the home is itself a protective measure; the house exists to shelter and secure the person.
cells_derived_method: The 4th house is home and security; its sign shows what kind of protection is wanted, for example fixed signs want solid permanent homes, movable signs want changing or travelling homes.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 4th house in Taurus, lagna Aquarius; the home protection is solid, comfortable and permanent property.
Derived: 4th house in Gemini, lagna Pisces; the home is shared, changing and communication-focused, protection through flexibility.

ambiguity: He does not name the 4th house; cell is my reading of home.
classical_check: 4th house as home is classical; the home as protection is a modern reading.

hindi: इसलिए अपने प्रोटेक्शन के खर्चे करो उपाय करो
says: Therefore spend money on your own protection and do the remedies, instead of keeping the money for show or for others.
ambiguity: Money advice here is about spending on remedies and protection, not investment advice; recorded only as said.
classical_check: Classical texts also prescribe daan and remedies at cost to the native; broadly agrees.

hindi: परमात्मा देता है और कहीं ना कहीं ठगे जाओ कहीं ना कहीं सही रास्ता मिल जाएगा
says: God provides, and even if you are cheated somewhere along the way, you will find the right path somewhere; do not stop searching for the right guide.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: He invites the audience member to speak: yes sir, go ahead.
Audience member explains the intent of his question: when we tell someone with social responsibilities to do or avoid a work, what is the reason.
Audience member says if planets are the reason it is okay, we understand that.
Audience member asks about a person who does the work deliberately and how the class caters to him.

hindi: हमने क्लास में ऐसा ऐसा कभी नहीं कहा कि कोई बोले कि यह तो दो नंबर का पैसा ही कमाएगा
says: He clarifies that he has never said in class that a person with a certain chart will only earn unclean money; the chart does not label a person as a wrongdoer in that blunt way.
cells_derived_method: none: he refuses a chart-to-unclean-money rule, so there is no house or sign variation to derive.
ambiguity: Reply to the audience question; it denies a claim and does not state a new rule.
classical_check: Classical texts do speak of yogas that give wealth by wrong means (for example 6th, 8th, 12th combinations), so this differs in spirit.

hindi: अगर जानबूझ के कोई कुछ नहीं कर रहा है वो वही कर रहा है जो लिखा है यह गलतफहमी है आपको
says: Nobody acts by deliberate choice as such; each person does what is written for them in the chart, and the belief that one acts deliberately is the audience member's misunderstanding.
ambiguity: The sentence is a little tangled; read as deliberate action being an illusion because destiny writes it.
classical_check: Consistent with the classical view of prarabdha karma; strict determinism is stronger than most classical writers.

hindi: कौन नहीं चाहता आज भारत का प्रधानमंत्री बनना पिछले 10 साल से कौन नहीं चाहता
says: Who does not want to become Prime Minister of India, and has not wanted it for ten years? Wanting is common but only one person gets it, so the outcome follows the chart and not the desire.
cells_derived_method: Rulership and high office are read from the 10th house and the Sun; since only the chart that carries those yogas delivers, no sign-wise rule is given.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 10th house in Aries, lagna Cancer; Aries gives a drive for leadership and command, and exalted Sun there is a classical sign of high office.
Derived: 10th house in Capricorn, lagna Aries; slow, structured rise to authority through persistence.

ambiguity: He uses a political example only to show that desire does not decide results; he does not name houses, the cells are my reading of high office.
classical_check: Agrees that 10th house and rajayogas determine office; silent on this exact argument.

gist: Political aside: the whole world wanted a particular US leader to lose and wishes India destroyed, yet it does not happen.
Says many want India to be ruined but it is not happening.

hindi: इतने सारे देश हैं भारत भी किया कराया क्यों नहीं करा देते ये जिन्नात फेंक दिए ये श्मशान की मिट्टी ला के पेल दी
says: He mocks the belief in black magic: if curses, jinn and graveyard soil worked, enemy countries would simply have done it to India, so such acts do not decide outcomes.
ambiguity: He is sarcastic, so the sentence is a rejection of the belief, not a description of a method.
classical_check: Classical texts mention abhichara and curse remedies, so this differs from the classical acceptance of tantric harm.

hindi: ये बकवास है यही सब हिप्नोसिस है जो राहु और केतु का खेला है
says: He calls the belief in black magic nonsense and says it is all hypnosis, the play of Rahu and Ketu, meaning the mind of the believer creates the effect.
cells_derived_method: Rahu and Ketu stand for illusion and hypnosis; where they sit shows where a person is most easily deluded, for example Rahu in the 12th gives imaginary fears of hidden enemies.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu in the 8th house in Scorpio, lagna Aries; strong pull to occult fears and fear of curses.
Derived: Rahu in the 12th house in Pisces, lagna Aries; illusions, sleep disturbances and imagined hidden enemies.

classical_check: Rahu and Ketu as deception and confusion is classical; saying black magic is only hypnosis is his own view.

gist: Says this was already discussed in the Rahu class and it does not work like that.
Says many women ask him for vashikaran.
Recently got an offer to lecture to fifteen to twenty thousand people at some place.
Organisers said you will gather five or six thousand people when you speak; he knows the volumes.
Says for decades he has not posted his photo on Facebook because platforms are already crowded.
Says if he did such dramas, a blind crowd would gather and he would put everyone in hypnosis.
Says he wants to teach breaking hypnosis, not create devotees and disciples.
Says sects create disciples, not gurus, and cites prabhupada as the only one he knows.
Asks which sect makes gurus; all of them make disciples.
Says those who follow a tradition are lineage gurus, not new ones who teach breaking hypnosis.
Praises Gaur Gopal Das for his work on Sanatan and salutes him.
Says a pupil who teaches what his teacher said and sits on the teacher's seat is not a guru in the sense of new knowledge.
Defines guru as one who brings something new, as Nanak did.
Says the ten Sikh gurus carried forward Nanak's teaching.
Says real knowledge means getting out of hypnosis; innovation is needed, as Einstein and Galileo showed.
Galileo was punished for saying the earth goes round the sun and the church later admitted he was right.
Says knowledge is different from gathering a crowd.
Says the guru must switch on inside you or you will hang about waiting.

hindi: गुरु जी आप हेल्प कर दो कृपा कर दो फिर वही झूठ है गुरु कृपा नहीं कर सकता गुरु डायरेक्शन बता सकता है
says: Asking the guru for help or grace is a lie; a guru cannot bestow grace, he can only show the direction, so a remedy-giver gives guidance and not a rescue.
classical_check: Differs from classical guru-kripa belief and from the usual idea that Jupiter or a guru's blessing changes outcomes.

gist: Google analogy: open Google and ask it to put you in Sonipat, it only says go left or right and gives directions.

hindi: अब गुरु थोड़ी उठा के ले जाएगा अमीर बन जाए वह तरीका बताएगा करना पड़ेगा
says: A guru will not carry you to the destination; if you want to become rich he will tell the method, but you have to do the work yourself.
ambiguity: Wealth mention is only an example of effort, not investment advice.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Krishna did not win the war for Arjuna; he could have ended it with the Sudarshan chakra but told him to get up and fight.
Says gaining knowledge is hard and complex and keeping a Gita on the shelf is easy; nobody works for it.
Claims less than one percent of hundred crore Hindus understand the word Sanatan.
Says such people need positive hypnosis created by wise teachers.
Claims a small surviving group among one community are the cream with big brains and the rest was discarded.
Says that top cream rules the world because all of them are leaders.
Says an elite needs no followers beneath it, they are all leaders and the world follows them.
Says when knowledge arrives you create everything.
Cites the Japanese as innovators who go to space and run a trillion-dollar economy on knowledge.
Says following old patterns blindly achieves nothing and only leads to lamenting.
Says everyone is doing good work for the uplift of Sanatan and gathering and managing crowds is also a job.
Says knowledge does not reach everyone and it is not easy for all to become wise.
Says most people are happy with tilak and temple bells, and that is necessary because ninety percent stay with it.
Says an army is never wise, it follows orders, and if soldiers got knowledge they would not fight.
Says ninety percent without knowledge are needed, but wise people are also needed to settle and manage them.
Says Hindus are scattered and have been left in a bad state.
Says we run on what was filled in our minds, such as being taught that Akbar was great.
Says things have changed in recent years and a Hindu has come who wants to act and says he will not kill you either; the wording is partly garbled.
Tells how Rama, after destroying Ravana's ego, refused Vibhishana's offer of the kingdom.
Says that is knowledge: Rama said keep it, I only came for Sita.
Says Sanatan means we will not die under pressure and will destroy the enemy but not ourselves, and we do not want your things.
Audience member says everyone is attracted to him and comes to his class.
He says people are drawn to his lifestyle and ideology, not to him; the caption is partly garbled.
Says they lack the courage that they see in another person.
Says he himself has many versatile blends and a strange kind of theatre.
Jokes that he is drama and pride and goes around in flashy clothes.
Dares the audience to wear such clothes, sing and dance with him.
Says children are scared of him and say they will not go out with him since he starts a scene on the road, yet they come back out of love.
Says everyone moves towards versatility, so learn all this and bring knowledge inside yourself.

hindi: इसके लिए आपको बहुत सारे प्लनेट्स का ब्लेंड चाहिए बहुत सा समझदारी चाहिए और बहुत से उपाय चाहिए
says: To become versatile you need a blend of many planets working in you, plus a lot of understanding and many remedies; one dominant planet gives a narrow personality.
cells_derived_method: Versatility would show where many planets are well placed across different houses and signs (fire, earth, air and water), so that the person shows several natures; he does not name planets, houses or signs.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Gemini, a dual air sign with Mercury, gives adaptable and many-sided personality when other planets also support.
Derived: 10th house in Sagittarius, lagna Pisces; a work life that combines teaching, travel and different roles.
Derived: 3rd house in Aquarius, lagna Sagittarius; skills and interests spread across many unusual fields.

ambiguity: Blend could mean many planets conjunct in one house or planets spread across the chart; not specified.
classical_check: Classical texts silent on versatility as a planet blend; they would speak of dual signs and Mercury.

hindi: हमारे ग्रह है जो वही है बाकी हमने वो धागे कस रखे हैं बाकी मां-बाप का लाड प्यार है
says: He says his own planets are what they are and he does nothing special; he has tied protective threads on himself as remedy and the rest is his parents' love, so remedy plus blessings carries him.
ambiguity: The caption about threads is garbled; read as he wears sacred threads or amulets as protection.
classical_check: Thread and amulet remedies are traditional; the claim of parents' love as a protection is silent in classical texts.

gist: Closes the class, thanks everyone, greets them and apologises for taking so much time.
Chanting of Om.
Final Om.
